scenes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Simple flat-colour inline story picture for Three Bells chapter three. Images 1 and 2 are style references: match clean simple Kasa Jizō inline art. Image 3 is only a character identity reference for Riku and Chika; do not copy its rich cover detail or texture. Show Riku and Chika beginning their dawn crossing on the exposed sand road. Before sunrise on a calm summer morning at Shiomi, a broad white sand road reaches from shore toward a low wooded island with sea on both sides. Riku, thirteen, has short dark hair, pale grey shirt, dark shorts and black backpack; Chika has a dark ponytail, rust-orange top and light neutral skirt. They walk side by side and look ahead; a few white shells lie on the sand. Landscape about 12:7, figures on the left third, broad road leading to island, two water bands and pale dawn sky. Flat matte colour planes, gentle outlines, tiny dark eyes, minimal faces, one simple shadow per surface, quiet layered background. Keep the road dry and fully walkable. No waves, phones, rising danger, bell detail, extra people, lettering, border, logo or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Simple flat-colour inline story picture for Three Bells chapter three. Images 1 and 2 are style references: match clean simple Kasa Jizō inline art. Image 3 is only a character identity reference for Riku and Chika; do not copy its rich cover detail or texture. Show the moment Riku and Chika first see the huge bell beneath the island tower. Early morning on the rocky island summit, a small old wooden house with a few missing roof tiles and one loose hanging door stands near a timber tower. Riku in pale grey shirt, dark shorts and black backpack stands beside Chika in rust-orange top and light neutral skirt. They look up at one large dark bronze bell hanging below the tower roof; it is about as tall as Riku. Chika is just stepping under the tower. Landscape 12:7; teens small under the simple timber tower, single clear bell with Riku for scale, damaged house to one side. Flat matte colours, clean gently imperfect outlines, tiny dark eyes, minimal face detail, broad shapes, one simple shadow and quiet rocks and trees. Show exactly one recognizable bell, because the prose has now named it. No elaborate carving, rich cover-level detail, multiple bells, new clues, extra people, lettering, border, logo or watermark.
